mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.identity_card as identityCard FROM swm_person p left join fms_worker w ON w.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = p.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE w.office_code = #{officeId} AND p.status = '0'

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.identity_card as identityCard FROM swm_person p left join fms_worker w ON w.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = p.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE w.work_shop_code = #{workshopId} AND p.status = '0'

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.identity_card as identityCard FROM swm_person p left join fms_worker w ON w.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = p.identity_card COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci left join fms_work_group g ON w.work_group_id = g.id WHERE g.prod_line_id = #{prodLineId} AND p.status = '0'
